description: This Kotlin source file defines several composable placeholder screens for an Android TV frontend application. It includes a generic PlaceholderScreen composable that displays a label and handles back key events, along with specific placeholder functions for various sections like Películas, Series, TV en vivo, Kids, and Mis Contenidos.

methods.name: PlaceholderScreen
methods.description: A composable that displays a placeholder screen with a label and handles back key events to trigger a callback.
